decision.rationale: The official address point and both mode transforms support a controlled concept for a parameterized site marker, and the selected compact mark can remain within one existing semantic tool. The visible raised feature changes geometry and appearance, so production source, meshes and 3MFs remain blocked until concept v05 is approved. After approval, regenerate and revalidate both modes. Exact filament profiles, ACE/purge review, process coupons, physical prints, assembled load behavior, lighting appearance, brand clearance and watermark approval remain required before release.
